headline: Bring governed workflows into Slack.
summary: Use Slack as the human coordination surface for durable AgentRuntime workflows: discover accessible channels and users, read conversation context, post messages, reply in threads, and add reactions.
cardSummary: Coordinate messages, threads, reactions, channels, and users while AgentRuntime keeps the workflow state.
authentication: The connector accepts a Slack bot or user OAuth token (xoxb- or xoxp-). Required scopes depend on the methods used.
workflowStart: Start the workflow from AgentRuntime or an external alert, then use Slack for conversation context, coordination, and updates.

outcomes.title: Incident coordination
outcomes.description: Post alerts, keep updates in a thread, and collect acknowledgements while AgentRuntime owns run state.

outcomes.title: Human-in-the-loop updates
outcomes.description: Pause for approval, then publish the decision back to the channel that triggered the workflow.

outcomes.title: Context-aware replies
outcomes.description: Read channel or thread history before agents draft the next action.

howItWorks: Install the Slack MCP connector and provide a token with scopes for the planned actions.
Bind an MCP instance to the workflow and select explicit tools per step.
Use human_task steps when channel posts need review before they go out.

configuration.description: Bot or user OAuth token with scopes for the Slack methods the workflow uses.
Workspace team ID used by channel and user discovery when no channel allowlist is configured.
Comma-separated channel allowlist that restricts channel discovery.
Override for the Slack Web API base URL.

faq.question: Bot or user token?
faq.answer: Bot tokens are typical for channel automation. User tokens are required for some private-channel patterns.

faq.question: Can workflows post to any channel?
faq.answer: Only channels the token can access. Use channel allowlists when you need a hard boundary.

faq.question: Does Slack hold workflow state?
faq.answer: No. Slack is the coordination surface; AgentRuntime retains durable run state and audit history.
